items.title: Warmest November Weather in 50 Years Checks Physical Natural Gas Prices
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices varied by region but fell overall to start the week, with bargain buyers picking their spots and sellers increasingly active amid exceptionally benign weather conditions by November standards.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Market Holds Its Breath as Weak Weather and War Risk Collide
items.summary: Natural gas futures seesawed on both sides of even on Monday as traders tried to gauge a feeble weather outlook against LNG demand and the potential for a post-election escalation of the war in Iran.

items.title: Natural Gas Discounts Offer Ammonia Producers Fall Savings, but Winter Costs Loom
items.summary: Regional natural gas basis prices continued to widen through the fall, offering advantages for US ammonia producers before a reshuffling for November, according to NGI’s Bidweek Alert and Entropic Analytics data.

items.title: Shell Lifts First Cargo at Plaquemines LNG After Commercial Operations Start at Phase 1
items.summary: Venture Global said over the weekend it has started commercial operations at the first phase of its Plaquemines LNG plant in Louisiana.

items.title: Natural Gas Storage in Europe Still Lagging, Creating Favorable Market for US LNG
items.summary: Slightly colder forecasts for Europe and Northeast Asia offered modest support for LNG demand Monday, though a largely mild start to winter in both regions leaves weather playing a smaller role than Europe’s below-normal storage.

items.title: Natural Gas Power Buildout for AI Faces Hurdles Ahead of Midterms
items.summary: On the eve of the US midterm elections, regulatory hurdles are emerging as additional constraints on the massive data center buildout required to fuel artificial intelligence (AI).

items.title: Comfortable Weather Keeping Natural Gas Futures Below $3
items.summary: December natural gas futures oscillated near even through midday Monday, failing to breach the psychological $3/MMBtu threshold as overwhelmingly bearish two-week forecasts weighed on sentiment.

items.title: European, Asian Natural Gas Prices Slide as Iran Talks Raise Hopes for LNG Relief
items.summary: Global energy prices fell Monday amid ongoing negotiations to avert renewed fighting between Iran and the United States.
